## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the compiler debugging workflow it improves.

## Evidence

- [ ] Linked issue, trace case, or roadmap item
- [ ] Screenshots or GIF for UI changes
- [ ] Trace quality / trace size output when relevant
- [ ] Repro bundle or command line when collector behavior changes

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run package`
- [ ] Manual VS Code smoke test
- [ ] L20 / real collector smoke test when touching collector, repro, or trace IO

## Risk

List compatibility, schema, large-trace, or collector-integration risks.
